title: The Attic Box
hook: Our new house came with one box in the attic... and a note that said never close it.
lines: The house we bought came with one thing the old owners wouldn't take. A cardboard box in the attic.
Taped to its lid was a note. Never close this box. And whatever ends up inside it... let it keep.
I laughed. It was just a box, sitting open in the dust.
A week later, my reading glasses went missing. I found them in the box.
Then my watch. Then my keys. Then my wedding ring.
Every time, I took them back. And every night, the attic floor creaked a little longer.
So one night... I taped the box shut.
The creaking stopped. For six days, the house was perfectly quiet.
Then my wife asked who I'd been whispering with in the attic every night.
I went up. The tape was split... from the inside.
The box was full. My shoes. My coat. Every photo of me... face scratched out.
Downstairs, I heard my wife laugh... and say my name. To someone in the kitchen.
I've been up here for a while now. She hasn't noticed I'm gone.
And the box keeps telling me... there's room.
